workbench_restore_body: This browser kept the profile you were editing and the paper you were viewing.
workbench_unsupported_lede: This workbench edits Liquid profiles in the browser. Eta and JavaScript run in Obsidian only, so this profile stays here unchanged, and it is neither edited nor rendered.
workbench_fields_lede: Select one to add it where your cursor is.
workbench_fields_trigger_hint: Type {trigger} in the note to open this list.
workbench_connection_disconnected: Connect to Obsidian to load and save the selected profile.
workbench_connection_revoked: The workbench connection was revoked. Your draft and item snapshot are retained.
workbench_connection_version_mismatch: This Local Bridge version is not compatible. Your draft and item snapshot are retained.
workbench_connection_disconnected_notice: Disconnected. Your draft and item snapshot are retained.
workbench_save_conflict: Revision conflict: the profile changed in Obsidian. Your draft and undo history are unchanged.
workbench_save_document_exists: Creation conflict: the built-in Default already has a profile document. Your draft and undo history are unchanged.
workbench_save_invalid: Save stopped because the profile source is invalid. Your draft is unchanged.
workbench_save_unsupported: Save stopped because this profile requires unsupported features. Your draft is unchanged.
workbench_note_lede: Write it like any note. The template parts fill in from Zotero.
workbench_advanced_lede: The manifest, the note source, and the annotation section as one document.
workbench_result_lede: For the paper above. Nothing is written until you download.
workbench_render_worker_failed: The preview stopped before it finished.
workbench_problem_unsupported_language: This profile is written in Eta, which the web workbench can't edit.
workbench_problem_unsupported_partial: The partial '{name}' is written in Eta, which the web workbench can't render.
workbench_problem_unsupported_js: The property '{key}' runs JavaScript, which the web workbench can't evaluate.
workbench_problem_unsupported_js_unnamed: One property runs JavaScript, which the web workbench can't evaluate.
workbench_problem_unsupported_recovery: Open the profile in Obsidian, or download it unchanged.
workbench_problem_invalid_document: This file is not a profile document.
workbench_problem_invalid_document_recov: A profile opens with a YAML manifest between two “---” lines.
workbench_problem_invalid_manifest_field: The manifest field '{field}' is not valid.
workbench_problem_invalid_manifest_recov: Correct the highlighted YAML in the manifest.
workbench_problem_invalid_managed_block: The managed block is not opened and closed correctly.
workbench_problem_invalid_managed_block_: Keep one open tag and one close tag around the managed block.
workbench_problem_duplicate_managed_bloc: Your note has more than one managed block.
Keep at most one managed block in your note.
workbench_problem_unknown_section_header: This line is not a profile section header.
Use only the standalone “--- zotlit:annotation ---” header. Your note starts after the manifest.
workbench_problem_duplicate_annotation_s: This profile has more than one annotation section.
Keep one “--- zotlit:annotation ---” header, followed by the annotation source.
workbench_problem_missing_annotation_sec: This profile has no annotation section.
Add one standalone “--- zotlit:annotation ---” line after your note. The annotation source can be empty.
workbench_problem_reserved_annotation_pa: The partial name 'annotation' is reserved for the annotation section.
Rename that partial and update the calls to it.
workbench_diagnostic_contract_mismatch: Item snapshot contract {found} does not match {expected}.
workbench_diagnostic_render_timeout: Rendering took longer than {deadlineMs} ms and was stopped.
workbench_diagnostic_citation_style_unre: Citation style '{styleId}' could not be read.
workbench_diagnostic_property_append_con: {key}: this entry could not append to the value an earlier entry set.
workbench_diagnostic_unsupported_depende: The template dependency '{name}' uses Eta, which the web workbench can't render.
workbench_properties_lede: Each row is one rule. Together they set the note's properties.
workbench_properties_empty: This profile sets no properties yet.
workbench_properties_source_only: This list is written in a form these rows can't edit. Open it in Advanced.
workbench_properties_javascript: This rule runs JavaScript. Open the profile in Obsidian.
workbench_properties_override_hint: A later property can override one of these fields.
workbench_name_lede: Where the note is filed, and what the profile calls itself.
workbench_name_unreadable: This profile isn't readable yet. Repair it in Advanced.
workbench_name_filename_source_only: This note name is written in a form this editor can't hold. Open it in Advanced.
workbench_name_bindings_lede: Use default follows the vault this profile lands in. Override writes the value into the profile.
workbench_name_binding_annotation_templa: Import annotations through the annotation section
workbench_name_default_lede: The built-in default profile keeps these in Obsidian, under ZotLit settings. They stay outside this document.
workbench_name_default_note: Read-only here. A profile named default that carries one of these is refused.
workbench_name_language_lede: One language for the note name, the note, and the annotation section.
workbench_name_language_confirm_body: This changes the manifest key alone. Review the note name, the note, and the annotation section yourself. No source is translated.
workbench_name_id_note: Minted when the profile is created. It stays with the profile when the name or the file changes.
workbench_name_locked_note: Compatibility fields are locked in this form. Advanced still opens them.
workbench_name_sample_item_type_note: A hint for loading sample data. It leaves the paper on screen as it is.
workbench_highlight_lede: One format for every highlight in the note.
workbench_highlight_later_call: How one highlight looks — edit it where it first appears
workbench_highlight_pointer: Every highlight in the note uses one format.
workbench_highlight_result_lede: One highlight from the paper above, in this format.
workbench_managed_end: End of the part kept up to date
workbench_section_missing: This profile has no annotation section.
